name: Document & Environment Photography
description: Systematic photography of the target environment during and after entry is the primary evidence collection method in physical red team engagements. This includes capturing access control system details, sensitive documents, server room contents, network infrastructure, whiteboard contents, and any other intelligence demonstrating the scope of access achieved. Body-worn cameras provide continuous coverage without drawing attention to the documentation act.

blue.det: Camera use in restricted area visible on CCTV; employee reports individual photographing sensitive materials; flash or phone screen visible.
blue.cm: Camera-detection systems in sensitive areas; no photography policy enforced at entry; visitor escort preventing unsupervised access; screen privacy filters; clean desk policy.
